svg.title: Engineering activity dashboard preview
svg.desc: Layout preview. The GitHub Actions workflow replaces these placeholders with real commit and code-change metrics after its first run.
svg.text: VISUAL PREVIEW ONLY · NO STATISTICS ARE BEING SHOWN
Merge the profile draft to enable the scheduled workflow. The chart will then use real public GitHub data.
Commit totals: up to 365 days. Code-change totals: latest up to 25 eligible commits in the past 30 days.
Line changes are code churn, not net code growth or code quality. Public push-event data may be incomplete.
